summary: Tegmark calls for safety standards and a halt to the race toward superintelligence while backing controllable AI tools for medicine and science.

statements.quote: Let’s build tools not beings & keep humans in charge.
There has to be a red line, that nobody is allowed to do recursive self-improvement.
All AI systems should be under meaningful human control. This is especially true for those that could be used in the taking of human lives.
AI has enormous potential for improving medical treatments, curing cancer and so on. This is not in the future; it’s in the past already.
statements.venue: Testimony, Canadian House of Commons ethics committee

statements.quote: I think right now we’re closer to figuring out how to build superintelligence than we are figuring out how to control it.
statements.venue: Doom Debates, debate with Dean Ball
